item.title: 'We had to scrap' - O'Neil praises Ipswich resilience after Forest draw
item.description:
⚽ Ipswich manager Gary O'Neil praises his side's ability to "dig in and fight" as his side come from behind to earn a 1-1 draw against Nottingham Forest at Portman Road in the Premier League.

item.title: Forest left frustrated as winless run goes on after draw at Ipswich
item.description:
⚽ Nottingham Forest ended a run of three successive league defeats but endured another night of missed chances as they drew 1-1 at Ipswich Town in the Premier League, but the result does move the away side out of the relegation zone on goal difference.
#Forest #Ipswich #Football #To1000

item.title: Borussia M'gladbach finally get first win after five-goal thriller
item.description:
⚽ Bundesliga's bottom side Borussia Monchengladbach come from behind to beat Stuttgart 3-2, as the away side secure their first league win of the season, at the seventh attempt.
#Borussia #Mgladbach #Football #To1000
